column1: # Coordinates that Open Liberty bundle poms or bnd projects name and that are not
# published as-is under that name. Columns: groupId:artifactId, version regex
#   internal          IBM build with no public artifact; no SBOM row.
#   version:<repl>    same groupId:artifactId, version rewritten with the regex.
#   as:<g>:<a>:<repl> different public coordinate, version rewritten.
#   public            a published coordinate whose groupId looks like an IBM build.
#   keep              emitted unchanged: an Open Liberty fork of third-party code
#                     that NOTICES lists and no public repository publishes.
# Every row must match at least one coordinate in the build, or the build fails.
